about: Capitals, major cities and the Labyrinth: positions measured from the annotated capitals map (or the campaign gazetteer), outlines RECONSTRUCTED from canon descriptions (shape) at indicative sizes. The novels give no city plans; every outline is labelled as reconstructed in the atlas. Compiled by scripts/compile-data.ts into public/data/settlements.json.

settlements.name: Rimuru
settlements.basis: Capital of the Jura Tempest Federation: a planned city laid out on straight streets in the Great Jura Forest, with the Labyrinth at its edge. Outline RECONSTRUCTED from that description; the novels give no plan.
settlements.source: Central World All Territories Nation and Capital.png (Sources of Truth/Source Map), registered to the Base Map by land-mask ECC homography (correlation 0.992, land IoU 0.96)

settlements.name: Ramiris Labyrinth
settlements.basis: Ramiris's labyrinth of one hundred floors, whose entrance lies in the capital Rimuru. The imperial camp outside it is the scene of the D+10 battle. Surface footprint RECONSTRUCTED (the labyrinth itself is underground); position from the campaign gazetteer.
settlements.source: data-source/gazetteer.source.json (ramiris-labyrinth)

settlements.name: Nasca
settlements.basis: Imperial capital of Nasca Namrium Ulmeria, the largest city of the Empire, walled, with the Emperor's castle at its centre. Outline RECONSTRUCTED.
